title: Arctic Realms
description: One of the most F2P friendly Minecraft server. Based on icy theme
body:
![Server banner](https://assets.arcticbd.net/banner/animated-optimized.gif)

ArcticRealms is an icy themed F2P Minecraft server filled with icy lands, friendly community and fun adventures. You can explore, fight, build, and enjoy cosmetics in a chill winter vibe. Join now and start your  journey in this realms! ☃️

**Gamemodes:**
- ❄️ Survival

- **Bedrock:** mc.arcticbd.net
- **Port:** 19132
